title: graph.json exporter + ingestion summary report
description:
Generate the client-facing artifact the Vue app consumes: export the SQLite graph to a single `graph.json` (nodes[] with id/type/name/attrs, edges[] with src/rel/dst/attrs) plus lightweight per-type indexes to keep client search fast. Also emit a human-readable ingestion summary/report (counts by node type, by edge type, top builders by #yachts, #regions, list of source files ingested vs skipped, dedup collision stats) as both console output and a `reports/ingestion-summary.md`. Keep graph.json size reasonable; if it grows large, split into per-type shards or a manifest. This closes the Phase 1 loop end-to-end.

Part of Phase 1 (Ingestion). This artifact is the contract between ingestion and the UI.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run ingest` produces graph.json containing all nodes and edges with the documented shape
graph.json includes per-type node indexes (or a manifest) usable by the client for fast lookup
An ingestion-summary.md report is written with counts by node type, edge type, and files ingested vs skipped
The exported node/edge totals match the SQLite row counts (no data loss on export)
Loading graph.json in a scratch script and traversing Yacht->Builder->Region works end-to-end
